title: Valid credentials rejected with 401 at login
summary: Logging in with a correct username and password still shows a 401 Unauthorized banner because the session token is checked before the password.

title: Dashboard fails to load data after API gateway restart
summary: After the API gateway restarts, the dashboard shows a Failed to fetch / ECONNREFUSED error state until the connection pool warms up.

title: Orders card overflows the viewport on narrow screens
summary: At narrow widths the orders table and legend card overlap and the status strip extends past the right edge of the page.

title: Orders table stuck on the loading spinner
summary: The orders page keeps showing the loading spinner and never renders the table when the pagination cursor is stale.

title: Editors get 403 when saving their own profile
summary: Users with the editor role receive a 403 Forbidden response when saving profile changes because the permission check reads the wrong claim.
